description: This file defines the ModuleBuilder class, which manages packages related to module building in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and building packages, as well as handling package modules and aliases.

classes.name: ModuleBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for managing module packages, including retrieving package lists, handling individual packages, building packages, and managing package modules and aliases.

methods.name: getPackageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available package names by scanning the package directory.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Returns an MBPackage object for the given package name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getPackageKey
methods.description: Fetches the key associated with a package by requiring its manifest file.

methods.name: getPackageModule
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific module within a package.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds all packages, with an option for a single or multiple package build.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Initializes the internal packages array by loading package data from the directory.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Retrieves node representations of all packages.

methods.name: getModuleAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of aliases for a given module name, including related modules.
